item.title: What is rat-hole mining? As the Meghalaya explosion kills 30, read why this practice continues despite govt ban and court orders
item.description: Rat hole mining was banned by the National Green Tribunal in 2014, yet the illicit practice remains in existence to this day.

item.title: Where the soul experiences union with Shiva: Read about the Bhavnath Fair held on Shivratri, known as Gujarat’s ‘Mini Kumbh’
item.description: Held at the foothills of Girnar, the centuries-old Bhavnath Fair, often called a “Mini Kumbh”, brings together sadhus and devotees from across India for sacred rituals, the Mrigi Kund bath, and Shivratri processions in devotion to Lord Shiva.

item.title: ‘I am a thakur, don’t mess with me’: HDFC employee Aastha Singh breaks silence on incomplete viral video; reveals she is now receiving rape threats
item.description: HDFC Bank employee Aastha Singh has clarified that a viral video of her invoking her caste was a reaction to harassment by a colleague’s relative. She alleges the clip was selectively edited and has since faced severe online threats and rape threats.

item.title: Apples, alarmism and half-truths: How media coverage is warping public perception of the India–US Trade Deal
item.description: Under the India-US trade agreement, the Indian government has reduced import duty on US apples from 50% to 25%, coupled with a Minimum Import Price (MIP) of Rs 75 to 80 per kg. This move effectively prevents very cheap and apples from flooding Indian markets and harming the business of local growers, as the landed cost would be around Rs 100 per kg or more after duty.

item.title: Assam govt’s anti-encroachment drive to free forest land is valid and needed, says SC: Read how Opposition and media have been vilifying a lawful process
item.description: The Supreme Court noted that encroachment on the forest land has "emerged as one of the gravest challenges confronting environmental governance in the country."

item.title: Infrastructure development under Yogi Adityanath government: A leap towards developed Uttar Pradesh
item.description: With capital expenditure at 19.5 percent and major allocations for roads, aviation, MSMEs, water supply and healthcare, Uttar Pradesh positions itself as a fast growing economy targeting a trillion dollar milestone in coming years.

item.title: Human capital, infrastructure, medical, job opportunities and more: Read details of the 10th budget presented by Yogi Adityanath government in UP
item.description: "UP's per capita income is estimated at ₹1,09,844, more than double the numbers of ₹54,564 in 2016-2017," Khanna stated.

item.title: From Nehru’s intelligence blind spots to Indira Gandhi’s CIA-linked meddling: Read Congress’ history of selling national interests for personal gains
item.description: From Nehru’s intelligence blind spots to Tashkent and the release of 93,000 Pakistani POWs, Congress has a long history of squandering India’s hard-won strategic leverage, and has no moral standing to accuse others of “selling” the nation.

item.title: The Wire columnist Ravi Nair lied, made baseless allegations and failed to substantiate them: Read how the Gandhinagar court verdict busts Leftist claims of victimhood
item.description: Through its counsels S V Thakkar and K P Raichura, the AEL alleged that between October 2020 and July 2021, accused Ravi Nair published defamatory content, particularly a series of tweets against the complainant on his X handle @t_d_h-nair, in addition to articles published on the anti-Adani website “Adani Watch”.

item.title: Promised ‘Dhanvarsha’, delivered death: Occultist Kamruddin poisoned three with laddus, stole Rs 2 lakh; already booked in two murder cases
item.description: Laxmi, Shiv Naresh and Randhir were discovered dead on Outer Delhi's Peeragarhi flyover on 8th February.
